title: Memristor Crossbars 2.0 Master Roadmap

description:

Phase 1 — Prove (memristor tiles): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (crossbar logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sneak paths): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (programming pulses): crossbar hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and datacenters-scale deployment begins.
